title: Geriatric Emergencies: Medications, Falls and Elder Abuse

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already splint hips, restrict spinal motion, control bleeding and keep patients warm. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Read a medication list for toxicity and for clashes with your PCP drugs
  2. Recognize common geriatric emergencies, including delirium
  3. Manage a fall: find the cause, protect the head, and spot elder abuse

Textbook: Chapter 45, PDF pages 3899–3915 and 3929–3955
slides.say: Welcome back. As EMRs, you already know how to splint a hip, restrict spinal motion, control bleeding and keep a patient warm. Now that you're practising as a PCP, you carry more drugs, you start IVs, and you work to targets like the head injury blood pressure. With older patients, every one of those tools needs extra care. Today we'll cover three things: how to read a medication list, both for drug toxicity and for clashes with your PCP drugs; the common geriatric emergencies; and how to manage a fall, including how to spot elder abuse.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。作为 EMR，你们已经会固定髋部、限制脊柱活动、止血和保暖。现在以 PCP 身份执业，你带的药更多，会开静脉，还要按颅脑外伤血压之类的目标值来处理。面对老人，这些工具每一样都要格外小心。今天讲三件事：怎样读药单，既找药物中毒，也查与你的 PCP 药物有没有冲突；常见的老年急症；以及怎样处理跌倒，包括怎样识别老人虐待。

slides.title: Why drugs hit older adults harder
slides.body:
• Slower liver and kidneys: drugs build up
  • More fat, less water: drugs last longer; the brain is more sensitive
  • Errors: small print, forgotten doses, double dosing (most common)
  • Several doctors, OTC products, someone else's pills
  • More diseases → more drugs → side effects → even more drugs

Best dose = the lowest dose that works: "start low, go slow". Toxicity often shows first as confusion.
slides.say: Why do medications cause so much trouble in older adults? The liver breaks drugs down more slowly and the kidneys clear them more slowly, so drugs build up. Older bodies have more fat and less water, so many drugs last longer, and the brain is more sensitive to them. Then come the errors: labels are hard to read, doses are forgotten, and the most common error of all is taking the same dose twice. Several doctors may prescribe without knowing about each other. It becomes a vicious circle: more diseases, more drugs, more side effects, then more drugs for the side effects. The rule is start low, go slow. And drug toxicity in older adults often shows up first as confusion.
slides.sayZh: 为什么药物在老人身上麻烦这么多？肝脏分解药物变慢，肾脏清除也变慢，药物就会蓄积。老人体内脂肪多、水分少，很多药作用时间更长，大脑对药也更敏感。还有用药差错：标签看不清、忘了吃没吃，而最常见的差错是同一剂吃了两次。几个医生可能各开各的药，彼此不知情。于是形成恶性循环：病多、药多、副作用多，再加药去治副作用。原则是「起始量低、加量要慢」。老人药物中毒还常常最先表现为意识混乱。

slides.title: The usual suspects
slides.body:
Drug groupLook for
Blood thinners (warfarin)bruising, nosebleeds, blood in urine or stool
NSAIDs, steroidsGI bleeding, dizziness, confusion
BP pills, diureticslow BP, dizzy on standing
Insulin, diabetes pillshypoglycemia that looks like confusion
Antihistamines, anticholinergicscan't pass urine, constipation, restless
Sedatives, antidepressantsunsteady, dizzy, confused, delirious
slides.say: The book lists a dirty dozen: the drugs that most often cause toxic reactions in older adults. Here are the ones you'll meet most. Blood thinners like warfarin cause bruising, nosebleeds, and blood in the urine or stool. Anti-inflammatories and steroids can cause stomach bleeding and confusion. Blood pressure pills and water pills drop the pressure, especially on standing, which leads to falls. Insulin and diabetes pills cause low sugar, which in an older person may look like simple confusion. Antihistamines and anticholinergic drugs can stop the patient passing urine and make them restless. Sedatives and antidepressants cause unsteadiness and delirium. When you see one of these on the list, look for its side effects.
slides.sayZh: 书里列了「肮脏的一打」（dirty dozen），也就是最常在老人身上引起中毒反应的药。挑你最常遇到的讲。华法林这类抗凝药会引起瘀青、鼻出血、尿血或便血。抗炎药和激素可能引起胃出血和意识混乱。降压药和利尿药会让血压下降，尤其是站起来的时候，从而导致跌倒。胰岛素和降糖药会引起低血糖，而老人低血糖可能看起来只是糊涂。抗组胺药和抗胆碱能药可能让病人排不出尿、烦躁不安。镇静药和抗抑郁药会引起站不稳和谵妄。在药单上看到这些药，就要去找对应的副作用。

slides.title: Check the list against your drugs
slides.body:
On the listYour drugBC rule
Viagra, Levitra within 24 h; Cialis within 48 hNitroglycerinDon't give
A blood thinnerIbuprofenDon't give
Liver disease, heavy drinking, malnutritionAcetaminophenMax 2,000 mg / 24 h
Significant kidney diseaseMethoxyfluraneDon't give
Glaucoma, enlarged prostateDimenhydrinate, ipratropiumUse with caution

BC also lists older age as a caution for dimenhydrinate.
slides.say: Now the PCP part: before you give any drug, check the list against it. EMRs give some of these drugs too, but you carry the bigger kit and take the deeper history, so catching these is your job. No nitroglycerin if sildenafil or vardenafil, Viagra or Levitra, was taken in the last twenty-four hours, or tadalafil, Cialis, in the last forty-eight. A blood thinner rules out ibuprofen. Liver disease, heavy drinking or poor nutrition cut the acetaminophen limit to two thousand milligrams a day. Significant kidney disease rules out methoxyflurane. Glaucoma or an enlarged prostate call for caution with dimenhydrinate and ipratropium, and BC also lists older age as a caution for dimenhydrinate.
slides.sayZh: 现在是 PCP 的部分：给任何药之前，先拿药单对照。这些药有些 EMR 也能给，但你的药箱更大、病史问得更深，所以发现问题是你的责任。二十四小时内吃过西地那非或伐地那非（伟哥、艾力达），或者四十八小时内吃过他达拉非（希爱力），就不能给硝酸甘油。有抗凝药，就不能给布洛芬。有肝病、大量饮酒或营养不良，对乙酰氨基酚每日上限降到两千毫克。有明显肾功能损害，不能给甲氧氟烷。青光眼或前列腺增生，用茶苯海明和异丙托溴铵要谨慎；BC 还把高龄列为茶苯海明的注意事项。

slides.q: A 76-year-old man has cardiac-type chest pain. BP 138/84, HR 72. He took Cialis (tadalafil) about 30 hours ago, and he takes warfarin. What's correct?
options: Give nitroglycerin: it's been more than 24 hours
No nitroglycerin: Cialis within 48 hours is a BC contraindication
Give ibuprofen for the pain instead
Give no drugs at all, because he's on warfarin
slides.say: Let's test your list-reading. A seventy-six-year-old man has chest pain that sounds cardiac. His blood pressure is one hundred thirty-eight over eighty-four, and his heart rate is seventy-two. He took Cialis, or tadalafil, about thirty hours ago, and he takes warfarin. What's correct? A, give nitroglycerin, because it's been more than twenty-four hours. B, no nitroglycerin, because Cialis within forty-eight hours is a BC contraindication. C, give ibuprofen for the pain instead. D, give no drugs at all, because he's on warfarin. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来检验一下你读药单的功夫。一位七十六岁男士胸痛，听起来像心源性。血压一百三十八比八十四，心率七十二。他大约三十小时前吃过希爱力，也就是他达拉非，平时还吃华法林。哪个正确？A 给硝酸甘油，已经超过二十四小时了；B 不给硝酸甘油，四十八小时内吃过希爱力是 BC 的禁忌症；C 改给布洛芬止痛；D 他在吃华法林，什么药都不能给。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. BC's nitroglycerin rule is twenty-four hours for Viagra or Levitra, but forty-eight hours for Cialis, so thirty hours is still too soon, and A is wrong. C is wrong twice: ibuprofen is contraindicated with a blood thinner, and it isn't a chest pain drug. D is wrong because warfarin doesn't rule out everything; for example, BC lists Entonox for cardiac chest pain when nitroglycerin is contraindicated.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。BC 的硝酸甘油规定：伟哥或艾力达是二十四小时，希爱力是四十八小时，所以三十小时还不够，A 错。C 错两处：吃抗凝药的人禁用布洛芬，而且布洛芬也不是治胸痛的药。D 错在华法林并不排除所有药物，比如 BC 列明：硝酸甘油禁忌时，心源性胸痛可以用笑气（Entonox）。

slides.title: Emergencies that hide
slides.body:
• Chest pain: nitro may drop BP more; remove a nitro patch if BP is low
  • Heart failure can pass for "old age": watch fluids; CPAP if criteria met
  • Back or belly pain: think aneurysm or dead bowel before constipation
  • Upper GI bleed: black stool is the most common first sign
  • Chest pain + arm BPs differing by ≥ 15 mmHg: think aortic tear
slides.say: Some emergencies hide in older adults. Chest pain is treated as in younger adults, but nitroglycerin can drop the pressure more, and if a hypotensive patient wears a nitro patch, take it off. Heart failure often passes for old age: tiredness, breathlessness on exertion, swollen ankles. Watch your fluids, and use CPAP only when the criteria are met. With back or belly pain, think of a leaking aortic aneurysm or dying bowel before you think of constipation. In an upper GI bleed, the most common first sign is black, tarry stool, not pain. And in any chest pain, check the blood pressure in both arms; a systolic difference of fifteen or more suggests a tear in the aorta.
slides.sayZh: 有些急症在老人身上会藏起来。胸痛的处理和年轻人一样，但硝酸甘油更容易让血压掉；低血压病人如果贴着硝酸甘油贴片，要撕掉。心衰常被当成「年纪大了」：容易累、活动后气短、脚踝肿。要注意补液量，只在符合标准时才上 CPAP。背痛或腹痛时，先想主动脉瘤渗漏或肠坏死，别先想便秘。上消化道出血最常见的首发表现是黑色柏油样便，而不是疼痛。任何胸痛都要测双臂血压，收缩压相差十五或以上提示主动脉撕裂。

slides.title: Delirium: hunt for the cause
slides.body:
• Drugs, toxins, withdrawal
  • Emotional, electrolytes
  • Low oxygen; Infection (pneumonia, UTI)
  • Retention of urine or stool; Ictal (seizure)
  • Undernutrition, dehydration; Metabolic
  • Subdural hematoma

PCP: BGL < 4.0 mmol/L → D10W 10–25 g IV; glucagon if no IV.
slides.say: When an older patient is newly confused, hunt for the cause with DELIRIUMS. D, drugs, toxins or withdrawal. E, emotional causes and electrolytes. L, low oxygen, from COPD, heart failure, a heart attack or pneumonia. I, infection, such as pneumonia or a urinary infection. R, retention: a full bladder or bowel. I, ictal, meaning a seizure. U, undernutrition or dehydration. M, metabolic, such as thyroid or kidney problems. S, subdural hematoma, a slow bleed around the brain. Delirium starts over hours to days and comes and goes; dementia develops over months or years. Always check the sugar. Below four, as a PCP you give D10W, ten to twenty-five grams IV, or glucagon if you can't get a line.
slides.sayZh: 老人新出现意识混乱，用 DELIRIUMS 口诀追查原因。D：药物、毒物或戒断。E：情绪因素和电解质。L：低氧，来自 COPD、心衰、心梗或肺炎。I：感染，比如肺炎或尿路感染。R：潴留，膀胱或肠道憋满。I：发作期，也就是癫痫。U：营养不良或脱水。M：代谢，比如甲状腺或肾脏问题。S：硬膜下血肿，也就是脑周围的缓慢出血。谵妄是几小时到几天内出现、时好时坏；痴呆是几个月到几年慢慢形成。一定要测血糖：低于四，作为 PCP 你静脉给 D10W 十到二十五克；开不了静脉就给胰高血糖素。

slides.title: Falls: what happened first?
slides.body:
ClueThink of
Rug, ice, poor lightingaccidental fall
Fell on standing uporthostatic hypotension: meds? black stool?
Dizzy or fluttering firstslow or fast arrhythmia
One-sided weakness, speech troublestroke
Felt a "snap", then fella fracture caused the fall
Sudden drop, no warning, can't get updrop attack
slides.say: Falls are the number one reason older adults visit the emergency department or are admitted to hospital. About half are accidents, like a loose rug or ice, and about half come from inside the body. So as a PCP, ask what happened before the fall. Patients often say they tripped, but careful questions may reveal dizziness or a fluttering heart just before. A fall on standing up suggests orthostatic hypotension: check the medications, ask about black stools, and compare lying and sitting blood pressures. One-sided weakness suggests a stroke. A snap felt before the fall suggests the hip broke first. And a sudden drop without any warning is called a drop attack.
slides.sayZh: 跌倒是老人看急诊和住院的头号原因。大约一半是意外，比如地毯松了、地面结冰；另一半来自身体内部的问题。所以作为 PCP，要问清跌倒之前发生了什么。病人常说是绊倒的，但细问可能发现跌倒前头晕或心慌。一站起来就跌倒，提示直立性低血压：查用药、问有没有黑便、比较卧位和坐位血压。一侧肢体无力提示卒中。跌倒前先感觉「啪」的一下，提示是髋部先断了才跌倒。毫无先兆突然倒地，叫跌倒发作（drop attack）。

slides.title: Injuries that hide after a fall
slides.body:
• Subdural hematoma: builds over days to weeks; headache, then drowsiness
  • By then the fall may be forgotten
  • Blood thinners make every bleed bigger
  • Neck: a narrowed spinal canal → cord injury from minor trauma
  • Brittle ribs → fractures, flail chest
  • Hip fracture: the most common bone injury from a fall
slides.say: Some injuries after a fall hide. The big one is the subdural hematoma, a bleed under the brain's outer covering. In older adults the vessels are fragile and there's more space around the brain, so blood can collect slowly over days or even weeks. The first symptom is usually a headache, often worse at night; then the patient gets drowsier as pressure builds. By then, everyone may have forgotten the fall. A blood thinner makes any bleed bigger, so take a head bump on warfarin seriously. In the neck, arthritis narrows the spinal canal, so even a minor injury can damage the cord. Ribs break easily. And hip fracture is the most common bone injury from a fall.
slides.sayZh: 跌倒后有些伤会藏起来。最要紧的是硬膜下血肿，也就是脑外层硬膜下面的出血。老人的血管脆、脑周围空间又大，血可以在几天甚至几周内慢慢积起来。第一个症状通常是头痛，常常夜里更重；随着压力升高，病人越来越嗜睡。到那时大家可能早忘了那次跌倒。抗凝药会让任何出血变大，所以吃华法林的人撞到头要认真对待。颈部的关节退变让椎管变窄，轻伤就可能伤到脊髓。肋骨很容易断。而髋部骨折是跌倒后最常见的骨科损伤。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: after a fall
slides.body:
BC Traumatic Brain Injury, Hip Dislocation/Fracture, Pelvis Binding and Hypovolemia protocols

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Spinal motion restriction per NEXUS / Canadian C-Spine
  • Head injury: SpO₂ ≥ 94%, head of bed 30°, loosen the collar
  • Hip: support with blankets; any hip dislocation = rapid transport
  • No pelvic binder for a hip fracture or a fall from standing

PCP adds

  • TBI: blood sugar 4.0–8.0 mmol/L
  • TBI: systolic > 120; IV at TKVO if already above 120
  • Shock: 20 mL/kg (max 2 L), reassess every 500 mL
  • TXA if indicated, but never for an isolated head injury
slides.say: After a fall, every licence level does the left column. Restrict spinal motion using NEXUS or the Canadian C-Spine rules. For a head injury, keep the saturation at ninety-four or higher, raise the head of the bed thirty degrees, and loosen the collar. Support an injured hip with blankets; any hip dislocation is rapid transport. BC says no pelvic binder for a hip fracture or a simple fall from standing. The right column is the PCP. For a brain injury, keep the sugar between four and eight and the systolic above one hundred twenty, with the IV just keeping the vein open if it's already above that. For shock, give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred, and TXA if indicated, never for an isolated head injury.
slides.sayZh: 左栏是跌倒后所有执照级别都做的：按 NEXUS 或加拿大颈椎规则限制脊柱活动；头部受伤时，血氧维持在九十四以上，床头抬高三十度，松开颈托；受伤的髋部用毯子支撑，任何髋关节脱位都属于快速转运；BC 规定髋部骨折或平地站立跌倒不用骨盆带。右栏是 PCP 的：颅脑外伤时把血糖维持在四到八、收缩压保持在一百二十以上，如果已经高于一百二十，静脉只以保持通畅（TKVO）的速度滴注。休克时按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液，每五百毫升复评；必要时用 TXA，但单纯颅脑外伤绝不能用。

slides.q: An 83-year-old woman on warfarin fell and hit her head 1 hour ago. GCS 14, headache, no other injuries, BP 112/68. As the PCP, which plan is right?
options: Give TXA now: she's on a blood thinner and within 3 hours
No TXA; aim for systolic above 120, sugar 4.0–8.0, head of bed at 30°
Lay her flat and keep her systolic near 90 to slow the bleeding
GCS 14 is a mild injury, so her head needs no special care
slides.say: Here's a PCP decision. An eighty-three-year-old woman on warfarin fell and hit her head an hour ago. Her GCS is fourteen, she has a headache, there are no other injuries, and her blood pressure is one hundred twelve over sixty-eight. As the PCP, which plan is right? A, give TXA now, because she's on a blood thinner and within three hours. B, no TXA; aim for a systolic above one hundred twenty, a sugar of four to eight, and the head of the bed at thirty degrees. C, lay her flat and keep her systolic near ninety to slow the bleeding. D, a GCS of fourteen is a mild injury, so her head needs no special care. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一位吃华法林的八十三岁女士一小时前跌倒撞到头。GCS 十四，头痛，没有其他伤，血压一百一十二比六十八。作为 PCP，哪个方案对？A 现在给 TXA，她在吃抗凝药，而且在三小时内；B 不给 TXA，目标收缩压一百二十以上、血糖四到八、床头抬高三十度；C 让她平躺，把收缩压控制在九十左右以减慢出血；D GCS 十四属于轻度损伤，头部不用特别处理。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. This is an isolated head injury, and BC lists isolated traumatic brain injury as a contraindication to TXA, whatever her medications, so A is wrong. BC's brain injury targets are a systolic above one hundred twenty and a sugar of four to eight, and a systolic of one hundred twelve may already be low for her. C would starve the injured brain of blood. D is wrong because a subdural bleed can grow slowly, especially on warfarin; a mild GCS now doesn't mean safe later.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。这是单纯颅脑外伤，BC 把单纯颅脑外伤列为 TXA 的禁忌症，不管她吃什么药，所以 A 错。BC 的颅脑外伤目标是收缩压一百二十以上、血糖四到八；而且一百一十二的收缩压对她来说可能已经偏低。C 会让受伤的大脑缺血。D 错在硬膜下出血可以慢慢变大，吃华法林时更是如此；现在 GCS 属于轻度，不代表以后安全。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Saline: small boluses, reassess often, listen for pulmonary edema
  • Blood thinner + head bump = suspect a slow brain bleed
  • TXA hard stops: isolated head injury, > 3 h, age < 12
  • Your drugs hit harder: "start low, go slow"; nitro drops BP more
  • Ask about beta blockers, BP and diabetes drugs: they change your vitals
slides.say: Now the risks that are new for you as a PCP. First, saline. It's very easy to overload an older person with sodium. Give small boluses, reassess often, and listen for pulmonary edema, which means fluid in the lungs. Second, a blood thinner plus a bump on the head means you suspect a slow brain bleed, even if the patient looks fine. Third, know TXA's hard stops: an isolated head injury, more than three hours since injury, or age under twelve. Fourth, your drugs hit older adults harder, so start low and go slow. And fifth, ask specifically about beta blockers, blood pressure pills and diabetes drugs, because they change how the patient responds to injury and to your treatment.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲作为 PCP 新增的风险。第一，生理盐水：老人非常容易钠超负荷。要小量推注、勤复评，注意听有没有肺水肿，也就是肺里积液。第二，吃抗凝药又撞了头，即使病人看起来没事，也要怀疑脑内缓慢出血。第三，记住 TXA 的硬禁忌：单纯颅脑外伤、受伤超过三小时、未满十二岁。第四，你的药对老人作用更强，所以起始量低、加量要慢。第五，要专门问 β 阻滞剂、降压药和降糖药，因为它们会改变病人对创伤和对你的治疗的反应。

slides.title: Elder abuse
slides.body:
Five types: physical, sexual, emotional, neglect, financial

  • Typical victim: about 80, female, several chronic illnesses, dependent
  • Abuser: usually known, often an adult child or spouse; mostly at home
  • Key clue: injuries that don't fit the story
  • Look at hygiene, the home, and how the caregiver acts
  • Unsafe? Offer transport; refuses → adult protective services; danger → police

Document carefully and report your concerns to the receiving facility.
slides.say: Elder abuse, or maltreatment, comes in five types: physical, sexual, emotional, neglect, and financial, which means misusing the older person's money or property. The typical victim is about eighty, female, with several chronic illnesses that make her depend on others. The abuser is usually someone she knows, often an adult child or a spouse, and it usually happens at home. The key clue is an injury that doesn't fit the story. Look at hygiene, the home, and how the caregiver behaves, and listen patiently. If it's unsafe, offer transport; if she refuses, adult protective services can help; if there's immediate danger, call police. Most cases are never reported, so document carefully and report your concerns to the receiving hospital.
slides.sayZh: 老人虐待分五类：身体、性、情感、忽视，以及经济虐待，也就是滥用老人的钱财或财产。典型受害者约八十岁、女性、有多种慢病，因此依赖他人照顾。施虐者通常是她认识的人，常常是成年子女或配偶，而且多发生在家里。关键线索是伤情和说法对不上。看看个人卫生、家里的状况、照护者的表现，并耐心倾听。情况不安全时，劝她去医院；她拒绝的话，成人保护服务可以帮忙；有即时危险就报警。大多数个案从未被报告，所以要仔细记录，并把你的担忧报告给接收医院。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Read the med list twice: for toxicity, and against your PCP drugs
  2. After a fall, ask what came first; blood thinner: suspect a brain bleed
  3. TBI: systolic > 120, BGL 4.0–8.0, no TXA; saline in small steps

Next: Chapter 46, Abuse
slides.say: Let's wrap up with three things to remember. One: read the medication list twice, once for drug toxicity, and once against every PCP drug you plan to give. Two: after a fall, always ask what happened first, and if the patient takes a blood thinner, suspect a slow bleed in the head, even if they look fine. Three: for a head injury, BC wants a systolic above one hundred twenty and a sugar of four to eight, with no TXA for an isolated head injury; and give saline in small steps. Next, Chapter forty-six covers abuse in more depth. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三件事。一，药单要读两遍：一遍找药物中毒，一遍对照你准备给的每一种 PCP 药物。二，跌倒后一定要问清之前先发生了什么；病人在吃抗凝药的话，即使看起来没事，也要怀疑颅内缓慢出血。三，颅脑外伤时 BC 要求收缩压一百二十以上、血糖四到八，单纯颅脑外伤不给 TXA；补生理盐水要小量分步。下一章，第四十六章，更深入地讲虐待。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
